decisions.label: More Seats to Add?

Flow.description: Creates one Beacon Subscription per seat when an Asset is created by Order activation (Revenue Cloud assetization). Runs when the Asset's Current Quantity is set or changes to 1 or more, the Asset has an Account and a Product, and it is not the Platform Bundle parent. Revenue Cloud leaves Asset Quantity blank and sets Current Quantity from the Asset State Period just after the Asset is created, so Current Quantity is used as the seat count. Creates only the seats that don't already have a Beacon Subscription (Current Quantity, rounded down, minus existing subscriptions), so it never creates duplicates. Start Date and End Date come from the Asset's Lifecycle Start Date and Current Lifecycle End Date (falling back to Lifecycle End Date). Contact is left blank. Does not remove subscriptions when the quantity goes down. Only runs when Run Flows is checked on the On/Off Switch custom setting.

formulas.description: The number of Beacon Subscriptions still to create: Current Quantity rounded down, minus the subscriptions the Asset already has.

formulas.description: Subscription End Date: the date part of the Asset's Current Lifecycle End Date (the end of the current term). Falls back to Lifecycle End Date when Current Lifecycle End Date is blank.
